$meta.note: THE single source of NibbleCue's brand values. Nothing in app code, store metadata or a test may type a product name, title, tagline, URL or identifier: it reads it from here (packages/brand/src/index.ts). A rename stays a one-file edit.

states.decided: the owner's decision, with its date. May appear anywhere it is needed, read from this file only.
states.proposed: the developer's proposal, NOT yet confirmed by the owner. A development build runs on it so the app can be tested; a release build refuses to start while any value is still here (apps/mobile/env.guard.cjs), and brand.test.ts keeps it out of store copy. Each is an owner question in docs/DECISIONS.md.
states.unconfirmed: a {{PLACEHOLDER}}: not decided, not owned, never presented as real.

decided.$decidedOn: 2026-10-08, the owner answering the NibbleCue kickoff: the store title ("NibbleCue - Baby Food Planner") and a subscription of its own ("this is a different subscription called nibblecue plus, and its different price too"). The developer name, the legal entity, the studio domain, the support page and the sending address are the studio's own decided values, carried from CuddleCue's brand.json (2026-09-14, 2026-09-21, 2026-09-27): one company, one domain, and one account system both apps share.

proposed.$note: Proposed by the developer on 2026-10-08 in the kickoff (question 7) following CuddleCue's pattern; the owner has not confirmed them. Each is set ONCE by the owner and never changed after the first store submission.
proposed.playShortDescription: A day by day solid food plan for your baby, from first bite to toddler meals.

$taglineNote: Proposed by the developer on 2026-10-08; the owner has not confirmed it.

unconfirmed.$warning: NOT decided, NOT verified, NOT owned. Never written into public copy, a policy, a footer or a store field.
unconfirmed.easProjectIdNote: The owner creates the EAS project with `npx eas-cli init` in apps/mobile (as for CuddleCue on 2026-09-25) and records its id here.
unconfirmed.appleTeamIdNote: The studio's Apple Developer team (owner, 2026-10-02, recorded for CuddleCue). The same team publishes NibbleCue.
unconfirmed.appStoreIdNote: App Store Connect gives it once the NibbleCue app record exists.
unconfirmed.androidSigningSha256Note: Play App Signing fingerprint, once the Play Console has the app.

assets.$status: PLACEHOLDER ARTWORK. The owner, 2026-10-08: "you can generate simple temporary icons that i will redesign later". Every file in brand/ carries `placeholder` in its name until the designer's kit arrives; CuddleCue's logo is never redrawn or reused for NibbleCue.

colors.$note: Placeholder artwork colors (the Leaf scheme's own, the green the owner chose on 2026-10-08) for the splash grounds and the notification tint. Never the app's palette, which is packages/ui/src/theme/design-tokens.json.

storeLimits.$note: Checked by assets/brand.test.ts so a copy edit cannot silently break a submission.
